claim_text: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is now generally available for building and running AI agents at scale.
AWS will launch a managed quantum computing Region in us-east-1 at re:Invent 2025.
Amazon EC2 P6e-GB200 UltraServers accelerated by NVIDIA Grace Blackwell are now available in all commercial AWS Regions.
Amazon Aurora DSQL is now generally available as a serverless distributed SQL database with active-active high availability.
Amazon S3 Vectors is now GA and lets you store and query vector embeddings natively in S3 at massive scale.
